items.title: Slide Hampton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Pistol Allen. Was he around? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. They were all there.

ctx.x: Yeah. They were all there. This was the height of their success. They had money, unbelievable amount of money. But they weren’t – like a lot of people, they weren’t willing to take any chances on making a big change musically. I can understand it. You can’t do it if you can’t feel it. You shouldn’t do it if you can’t feel it. They were –
